label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-TP: User-controlled param flows through File constructor -> getCanonicalPath() -> Files.readAllBytes(). Although prefix check exists, canonical path normalization can be bypassed via symlinks, hardlinks, or platform-specific edge cases. Resolved sink value 'norm' depends on attacker input param on executed path. Path traversal vulnerability exists.

evidence.note: User param flows to File constructor, canonical path computed, then used in readAllBytes()
